keyVerseDR: "...whosoever shall give to drink to one of these little ones a cup of cold water... shall not lose his reward." (Mt 10:42)

level1.title: A Cup of Water
level1.story: Jesus said, "Whoever welcomes you welcomes Me." Even a cup of cold water given in love counts. Small acts of love matter to God!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What small gift did Jesus talk about?
What kind thing can you do?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me show love in small ways. Amen.

activity.title: Cups of kindness
activity.intro: Stamp or draw a cup each time you help someone.

level2.title: Welcome and Reward
level2.story: Jesus said whoever loves father or mother more than Him is not worthy of Him. "Whoever does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me." He said, "Whoever welcomes you welcomes Me." Whoever welcomes a prophet will receive a prophet's reward. Jesus promised that whoever gives even a cup of cold water to a little one will not lose their reward.
level2.keyLine: He shall not lose his reward.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does it mean to love Jesus most?
How can you welcome others like Jesus?
level2.prayer: Jesus, I love You above all things. Amen.

activity.title: Share with others
activity.intro: Even a cup of water counts! Plan what you can give.

art.mainBrief: Child giving a cup of water to a friend
